title: Schelling Deals
tag: NEAR testnet · scripted buyer agents · github.com/gryyny/schelling-deals
lines: Four small buyers. One volume price: 0.10 NEAR/unit if at least 10 units sell together.
Usually a platform or coordinator runs the pool: opens the round, holds the money, can change the rules.
Here, nobody does.

title: What it guarantees, and what it does not
lines: Guaranteed by the contract:
seller paid only at the minimum, and only once
otherwise every buyer can reclaim exactly what they paid (claimable; anyone may trigger it)
terms cannot change: they are the address; no keys, no admin, no upgrade
Not guaranteed:
that the seller delivers (delivery is recorded on-chain, not enforced)
NEAR testnet. Buyer agents are scripted rules, not models.
Also tested on testnet: concurrent creation, changed terms, retried pledge, late pledge,
settle below/at minimum, double settle, refunds, failed payout.
